REGULATIONS made by the Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms, under Section 115A read with Section 6A andsection 19A of the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87).
THALATHA ATHUKORALA,Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms,
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Trusts (Information Relating to Express Trusts) Regulations 2019.

2. (1) Upon creation of an express trust under Section 6 of the Trusts Ordinance in relation to any immovable ormovable property, the trustee of such trust shall, for the purpose of subsection (1) of Section 19A of that Ordinance, keeprecords of information specified in Schedule I.
(2) The information kept under Sub-regulation (1) shall be verified and updated every three months to the greatestextent possible.

3. The Registrar General shall, for the purpose of subsection (1) of Section 6A of the Trusts Ordinance, prepareand maintain a register containing the information specified in Schedule II in respect of every express trust.

4. (1) The trustee of any immovable property or movable property in respect of an express trust shall, for thepurpose of subsection (2) of Section 6A, forward the information specified in Scheduel III –

(a) to the Register of Lands of the area within which the trust property is situated, along with the original of the
instrument of trust, for registration ; and
(b) to the Registrar General, along with the counterpart original of the instrument of trust.

(2) The trustee of any immovable or movable property in respect of an express trust that has been created prior tothe date of coming into operation of these Regulations shall comply with the provisions of sub-regulation (1) within sixmonths from the date of coming into operation of these Regulations.

(3) Where there is any update in the information in respect of any express trust forwarded to the RegistrarGeneral and the relevant Registrar of Lands under sub-regulation (1) or (2), the trustee of such express trust shallimmediately forward such updated information as specified in Schedule III, along with the prior registration details of theinstrument of trust, to the Registrar General and the relevant Registrar of Lands.

5. (1) The Registrar General shall require every Registrar of Lands to maintain a registrar in the form specifiedin Schedule IV (Hereinafter referred to as the “Day Book”) to enter the information on express trusts receivedunder Regulation 4.
(2) The original of every instrument of trust submitted to any Registrar of Lands under Regulation 4 shall,upon registration, be returned to the trustee of the relevant express trust.
6. For the purpose of these regulations -
(a) in the case of a person who is citizen of Sri Lanka-
(i) a National Identity Card issued by the Commissioner General for the Registration of Persons ;
(iv) in the absence of any of the documents referred to in (i), (ii) or (iii) above, a photograph certified by
a Notary Public or a Justice of the Peace ; and
(b) in the case of a person who is not a citizen of Sri Lanka, a valid passport and a valid Visa.
7. The Trusts (Information Relating to Express Trusts) Regulations 2018 published in the Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 2099/20 of November 28, 2018 is hereby rescinded.
